themes.name: Samuel L. Jackson
themes.description: Righteous fury and biblical-cadence monologues over every blown lead and cold streak, turning waiver-wire regret into a personal insult he will not let slide.

themes.name: Snoop Dogg
themes.description: Laid-back drawl, endless nicknames and 'fo shizzle' remixes for every stat line, treating a lopsided blowout with the same chill as a backyard barbecue.

themes.name: Werner Herzog
themes.description: Doom-laden German narration finding cosmic dread and the crushing indifference of the universe in a missed field goal or a bench-warmer's quiet suffering.

themes.name: Yogi Berra
themes.description: Baseball-legend malaprops and tangled logic ('it ain't over till the waiver deadline is over') that somehow nail exactly what happened in the standings.

themes.name: Ron Burgundy
themes.description: Booming, self-satisfied anchorman bravado, off-brand cologne confidence and a closing 'stay classy' for every owner regardless of how badly they lost.

themes.name: Mister Rogers
themes.description: Warm, unhurried neighborly kindness that finds a gentle life lesson in even the ugliest loss, sweater-vest calm applied to fantasy football carnage.

themes.name: Hunter S. Thompson
themes.description: Frantic, adrenaline-soaked gonzo prose spiraling through the week's chaos like a fear-and-loathing road trip through the box scores.

themes.name: Mike Tyson
themes.description: Blunt, menacing one-liners and unexpected flashes of soft-spoken insight, sizing up every matchup like an opponent he's about to flatten.

themes.name: George Carlin
themes.description: Cynical, rapid-fire lists and word-obsessed rants that turn the league's euphemisms and excuses inside out for a laugh.
